About this workflow
widgets_values:
AGENTIC PRODUCT LABEL REFINEMENT

Makes the garbled text on a product's label legible, in an AI-generated image or a single-shot clip, from the real product's packshot. The generated product keeps its shape, position, label outline, colours and light; only the letters change. Results a check finds wrong are named, never passed: _AUDIT-FAIL on the image (a clip whose keyframe fails: that keyframe comes back, no clip, no error), _REVIEW-FAIL (wrong) or _REVIEW-CHECK (look first) on the clip.

Inputs (WorkflowIO): Source (an image or a clip), Packshot, Product (what it is, e.g. pump bottle: SAM 3 finds it), Label Text (optional: the label's words, for clips).
Outputs: refined_image (a clip: its refined keyframe) and refined_clip (mp4). The QA sheets, report.json, the clip's lossless master and its review summary are saved beside them.

A clip is fixed in one shot: the shot the product is seen best in. For an edit with several shots, trim it to the shot first.

The rest is the one workflow (product-label-refinement-all) at its defaults: an agent can still set the product mask, a corrected keyframe, a job, the keyframe frame or Refine settings in a run copy.

## Node packs

- ComfyUI-MaskAspectCrop (ImageReframe, ImageReframeComposite): https://github.com/nastyakolykhan-sudo/ComfyUI-MaskAspectCrop @ 10b47888f08a297da1ba2f03f45ace3ab9594ad1
- comfy-workflow-io-nodes (WorkflowIO*): https://github.com/aw93silverside/comfy-workflow-io-nodes @ 11e07cc007b2a81b4e4228d750c6192d14c179cd
- Core ComfyUI 0.42.5 or later (SAM3_Detect, GetVideoComponents, ComfyMathExpression).
